content.contents: dunkey played this game for his gamejam. it was awesome to see! he sang along to music i made! sick. i've been watching dunkey for for eeeever. hano made this cover art. i love the tracks on this album. i made it all over the course of 3-4 days. i think i spent like 9 hours working one day just on a couple of tracks. but it sure did work well! lightning in a bottle (not to toot my own horn, as they say)
